item.tib: ma mo yang snying 'dus pa'i rgyud las zlog pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: bdag 'dra mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa can gyis gyim shod zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba nas gter du spyan drangs te mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya gtad tsam bkrol ba'i stang bzhag tshod dang sbyar nas 'bri rdza zab mo (zal ma) sgang du gtan la phab cing / yi ge pa ni g.yung drung dar rgyas can gyis sgo gsum spyi dril du bgyis pas/ dge des gshen bstan bsrung ba'i mtshon cha gyur nas/ rnam rmongs 'gro rnams rnam mkhyen yum gyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
